prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1146; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured states the other vehicle drifted into their lane without signaling. Both drivers reported as ambulatory at scene. Police report requested.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant reports headache, dizziness, and ringing in the ears since the collision and has been advised to seek medical evaluation. Claimant has not retained an attorney and asked what the claims process involves. Provided general information on steps, timelines, and documentation needed.

Entry 3: Claimant provided a copy of an urgent care visit summary. Diagnosis noted as concussion with recommendation for rest and follow-up with a primary care provider. Requested signed medical authorization so records can be obtained directly. Claimant agreed to return the form.

Entry 4: Reviewed photos from both vehicles. Damage consistent with side-to-side contact on the rear quarter panel of the insured vehicle and the front passenger side of the other vehicle. Scene diagram in police report indicates both vehicles were changing lanes at the time of contact. Liability currently under review.

Entry 5: Claimant called to ask about rental coverage and the status of the injury portion of the claim. Explained that the injury evaluation will remain open until treatment is complete and records are received. Reminded claimant they are free to consult an attorney at any time and that the adjuster cannot give legal advice. Follow-up call scheduled for next week.
